sentences.en: This is a ridiculous special bonus episode of the 99% Invisible Breakdown of The Power Broker.
sentences.zh: 这是一期关于《权力掮客》的《99%无形》拆解节目的特别加更，内容荒诞至极。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: A few months ago, Elliot had an idea.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，埃利奥特有个想法。

sentences.en: Roman, I just want to say you did an amazing job of condensing the last episode down really little.
sentences.zh: 罗曼，我只想说你把上一集内容浓缩得非常精炼，做得太棒了。

sentences.en: And I just want to say there should be a podcast called the 99% Invisible Power Broker Breakdown Breakdown,
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得应该出一档播客叫《99%无形：权力掮客拆解之拆解》，

sentences.en: where it's just those sections at the beginning, just the catch-up section.
sentences.zh: 里面只放那些开头的回顾部分。

sentences.en: If you string those together, you could digest this whole book probably in like, I don't know, 15, 20 minutes
sentences.zh: 如果你把这些串联起来，大概只需要，我不知道，15到20分钟，

sentences.en: when the series is over.
sentences.zh: 等整个系列结束时，你就能消化整本书了。

sentences.en: So keep that in mind for the future for the Ultra Abridged Edition.
sentences.zh: 所以未来可以考虑做个“超精简版”。

sentences.en: Say you started the book, but you put it down for a while, and you want to get back up to speed
sentences.zh: 假设你开始读这本书，但中途搁置了一段时间，想在重新投入阅读前

sentences.en: before you dive back in.
sentences.zh: 快速找回状态。

sentences.en: Or you read the whole book, but you want a little refresher.
sentences.zh: 或者你读完了整本书，但想稍微温习一下。

sentences.en: For you, we present the 99% Invisible Power Broker Breakdown Breakdown.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们为你呈现《99%无形：权力掮客拆解之拆解》。

sentences.en: It starts with a summary of the first five chapters way back in our second episode from February 2024.
sentences.zh: 它始于我们2024年2月第二期节目中对前五章的总结。

sentences.en: So let's just start where we left off last time.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们就从上次结束的地方开始吧。

sentences.en: At the end of chapter five, it's November, it's 1918.
sentences.zh: 第五章结束时，时间是1918年11月。

sentences.en: Robert Moses is about to turn 30.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·摩西即将满30岁。

sentences.en: His career in public service has almost ended at this point.
sentences.zh: 此时他的公共服务生涯几乎已经走到尽头。

sentences.en: Like he's complete failure.
sentences.zh: 可以说他彻底失败了。

sentences.en: All of his different programs he has proposed have failed.
sentences.zh: 他提出的所有不同方案都失败了。

sentences.en: But then he gets a call from his former boss's wife, Belle Moskowitz.
sentences.zh: 但随后他接到了前老板妻子贝尔·莫斯科维茨的电话。

sentences.en: Let's get to our recap.
sentences.zh: 让我们进入回顾环节。

sentences.en: We're going to sort of pick up where we left off at the end of chapter 10.
sentences.zh: 我们将从第十章结束的地方继续讲起。

sentences.en: It's 1924, and the New York State Legislature has just passed a bill written by Robert Moses,
sentences.zh: 那是1924年，纽约州议会刚刚通过了罗伯特·摩西起草的一项法案，

sentences.en: giving him enormous hidden power to appropriate and govern land to the new State Council of Parks
sentences.zh: 赋予了他巨大的隐形权力，可以为新的州立公园委员会征用和管理土地，

sentences.en: that is run by Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 而这个委员会正是由罗伯特·摩西掌管的。

sentences.en: He wants to build a string of parks connected by parkways on Long Island,
sentences.zh: 他想在长岛修建一连串由公园大道连接的公园，

sentences.en: with his biggest dream being Jones Beach, which he envisions as the greatest bathing beach in the world.
sentences.zh: 他最大的梦想是琼斯海滩，他将其设想为世界上最棒的浴场。

sentences.en: And the part that we're going to be talking about today is the use of power, where we find out where he gets things done.
sentences.zh: 我们今天要讨论的部分是权力的运用，我们将揭示他是如何把事情办成的。

sentences.en: So when we left off last episode in a stunning turnabout, young idealist reformer Robert Moses
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们上一集结束时，出现了一个惊人的转折：年轻的理想主义改革者罗伯特·摩西，

sentences.en: has turned around and embraced corruption and dirty dealings to get things done.
sentences.zh: 已经转过身来，拥抱了腐败和肮脏的交易，以达成目的。

sentences.en: And this is the freight train that has been coming at us from page one.
sentences.zh: 这就是从第一页开始就向我们冲来的那列货运火车。

sentences.en: The heel turn is taking place.
sentences.zh: 他正在发生彻底的转变。

sentences.en: And as a result, in three years with the backing of Governor Al Smith,
sentences.zh: 结果就是，在州长阿尔·史密斯的支持下，他在三年内，

sentences.en: he massively expanded the amount of public park space in New York State.
sentences.zh: 大规模扩张了纽约州的公共公园空间。

sentences.en: He turned Jones Beach into the world's greatest weekend spot and built expressways leading to all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 他把琼斯海滩变成了世界上最棒的周末度假地，并修建了通往那里的高速公路。

sentences.en: And he has become this absolute hero to New Yorkers.
sentences.zh: 他成了纽约人心目中绝对的英雄。

sentences.en: He's seen as this man who stands up to the wealthy and he can get stuff done.
sentences.zh: 他被视为敢于对抗权贵且能办成实事的人。

sentences.en: He creates parks for the people,
sentences.zh: 他为人民创造了公园，

sentences.en: even though we've seen that, you know, he will totally get in bed with these powerful
sentences.zh: 尽管我们已经看到，为了让项目得以实现，他完全会与那些权贵

sentences.en: people to make his projects possible and he will ruin some small time farmers.
sentences.zh: 同流合污，甚至会毁掉一些小农户。

sentences.en: He does some dastardly stuff, but the public doesn't see that.
sentences.zh: 他做了一些卑劣的事，但公众看不到这些。

sentences.en: They just see these beautiful parks he's made.
sentences.zh: 他们只看到了他建造的那些美丽的公园。

sentences.en: And this public idea of Robert Moses and the private reality of how Moses gets things done
sentences.zh: 公众心目中的罗伯特·摩西与摩西私下办事的现实，

sentences.en: are really diverging at this point.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上确实出现了分歧。

sentences.en: And through this, and the reason why he's able to get all this stuff done is he has the support of Al Smith.
sentences.zh: 通过这些，以及他之所以能办成所有这些事的原因，是他拥有阿尔·史密斯的支持。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, in 1928, Al Smith runs for and loses the presidency.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，1928年，阿尔·史密斯竞选总统并失败了。

sentences.en: He cannot run for president and run for governor at the same time.
sentences.zh: 他不能同时竞选总统和州长。

sentences.en: So he goes to the presidency.
sentences.zh: 所以他去竞选总统了。

sentences.en: He reaches for that brass ring.
sentences.zh: 他试图摘取那枚金戒指。

sentences.en: He does not reach that brass ring at all.
sentences.zh: 但他根本没摘到。

sentences.en: And Robert Moses is left trying to do the things he's trying to do.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·摩西只能独自尝试去完成他想做的事。

sentences.en: But there's a new governor in office.
sentences.zh: 但办公室里换了一位新州长。

sentences.en: And this is the man who Caro promises will be one of Moses' most powerful enemies.
sentences.zh: 这就是卡罗承诺的摩西最强大的敌人之一。

sentences.en: He is known as the Feather Duster.
sentences.zh: 他被称为“鸡毛掸子”。

sentences.en: So when we last left the power broker, the depression is dawning.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们上次离开《权力掮客》时，大萧条即将来临。

sentences.en: Robert Moses keeps opening state park projects.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·摩西不断开启州立公园项目。

sentences.en: And to great public acclaim, he's just a hero.
sentences.zh: 他赢得了巨大的公众赞誉，简直就是英雄。

sentences.en: Moses gets Governor Lehman and Mayor LaGuardia to give him total control over anything remotely
sentences.zh: 摩西让莱曼州长和拉瓜迪亚市长给了他完全的控制权，可以管理纽约市任何与

sentences.en: park-related in New York City.
sentences.zh: 公园相关的事物。

sentences.en: And passes a new law where a state person and a city person can do all this stuff at once.
sentences.zh: 并出台了一项新法律，让州政府官员和市政府官员可以同时处理所有这些事情。

sentences.en: He immediately refurbishes New York City's major parks.
sentences.zh: 他立即翻新了纽约市的主要公园。

sentences.en: He's unveiled this massive plan for building expressways and bridges through and around the
sentences.zh: 他公布了一项宏大的计划，在城市内外修建高速公路和桥梁，

sentences.en: cities so that people don't have to go through Manhattan to get to places on either side anymore.
sentences.zh: 这样人们就不必再穿过曼哈顿去往两侧的地方了。

sentences.en: And the Triborough Bridge Authority has begun to actually start building the Triborough Bridge,
sentences.zh: 三区大桥管理局已经开始着手修建三区大桥，

sentences.en: which will become the centerpiece and provide all the funding for his empire as well.
sentences.zh: 这将成为他帝国的核心，并为他提供所有的资金。

sentences.en: But there's a little bit going on here where his pettiness is starting to seep out to people who are his staunchest allies.
sentences.zh: 但这里发生了一点小插曲，他的小气开始显露出来，甚至针对他最坚定的盟友。

sentences.en: So, you know, he destroys the Central Park Casino just because it was Jimmy Walker's playground.
sentences.zh: 比如，他摧毁了中央公园赌场，仅仅因为它曾是吉米·沃克的游乐场。

sentences.en: And he just, out of spite, he just wants to level it instead of turning it into something equally good or better, you know.
sentences.zh: 他纯粹出于恶意，只想把它夷为平地，而不是把它改造成同样好甚至更好的东西。

sentences.en: And so, that's where we are.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我们目前的情况。

sentences.en: So, he's still like in that phase where he's getting a lot done.
sentences.zh: 他仍然处于那种能办成很多事的阶段。

sentences.en: Most people are on his side.
sentences.zh: 大多数人都站在他这一边。

sentences.en: But that is about to take a turn right now with Chapter 21, The Candidate.
sentences.zh: 但随着第21章《候选人》的到来，情况即将发生转变。

sentences.en: When we last left the power broker, Robert Moses had run for governor.
sentences.zh: 当我们上次离开《权力掮客》时，罗伯特·摩西曾竞选过州长。

sentences.en: He had been such an unlikable, unpleasant candidate that he lost more than any major party candidate had ever lost before.
sentences.zh: 他是一个如此令人讨厌、不讨喜的候选人，以至于他输掉的票数比以往任何主要政党候选人都多。

sentences.en: And his reputation is tarnished.
sentences.zh: 他的名声受损。

sentences.en: He's completely on his ass.
sentences.zh: 他彻底栽了跟头。

sentences.en: But President Roosevelt, an unlikely savior, in an attempt to remove him for good,
sentences.zh: 但罗斯福总统，这位不太可能的救星，为了彻底除掉他，

sentences.en: has an order issued stating that New York City will get no more WPA money until it fires anyone holding both a city and a state office.
sentences.zh: 下令规定：如果纽约市不解雇任何同时担任市职和州职的人，就将不再获得任何公共事业振兴署（WPA）的资金。

sentences.en: This was an order written just to expel Moses.
sentences.zh: 这道命令就是为了驱逐摩西而写的。

sentences.en: Moses leaks this to the press.
sentences.zh: 摩西把这事泄露给了媒体。

sentences.en: He's able to frame this as the federal government trying to push around the people of New York City.
sentences.zh: 他成功地将其包装成联邦政府试图欺压纽约市民。

sentences.en: And it is just what Moses needed to get his halo affixed back over his head.
sentences.zh: 这正是摩西所需要的，让他头上的光环重新戴了回去。

sentences.en: And under Mayor LaGuardia, Moses perfects the system of providing physical achievements for politicians to run on while threatening to resign if he doesn't get his way.
sentences.zh: 在拉瓜迪亚市长手下，摩西完善了一套系统：为政客提供可供竞选的政绩，同时威胁说如果不能如愿就辞职。

sentences.en: Although LaGuardia finds a way to take the piss out of him in this regard a little bit.
sentences.zh: 尽管拉瓜迪亚在这方面找到了一些嘲弄他的方法。

sentences.en: Over the course of the last section, Moses is even more flagrant about ignoring orders and laws that get in his way.
sentences.zh: 在上一节中，摩西在无视阻碍他的命令和法律方面变得更加明目张胆。

sentences.en: And he's even more ruthless about just destroying people who are trying to stop him from achieving his ends.
sentences.zh: 对于那些试图阻止他实现目标的人，他变得更加冷酷无情。

sentences.en: But at the same time, he's beginning to get stretched pretty thin.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他开始感到力不从心。

sentences.en: He's doing all these jobs around the city.
sentences.zh: 他在城市各处同时处理着所有这些工作。

sentences.en: Most of them are not as accomplished or as thoughtful as like Jones Beach.
sentences.zh: 其中大多数项目都不如琼斯海滩那样成就斐然或深思熟虑。

sentences.en: And it is very clear that he's underserving New York City's poor and non-white population.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他忽视了纽约市的贫困人口和非白人人口。

sentences.en: And we'll see more of that ruthlessness and neglect in this episode.
sentences.zh: 我们将在本集中看到更多这种冷酷和忽视。

sentences.en: Because what's clear that Caro is getting to at the end of the last section was that this is not a man in love with his mission, a man in love with Parks.
sentences.zh: 因为卡罗在上一节末尾所揭示的显而易见的是，这并不是一个热爱自己使命、热爱公园的人。

sentences.en: He's become a man who's just in love with power, the love of power.
sentences.zh: 他已经变成了一个仅仅热爱权力、沉迷于权力的人。

sentences.en: The rest of the 99% Invisible Power Broker Breakdown Breakdown, when we come back.
sentences.zh: 《99%无形：权力掮客拆解之拆解》的其余部分，稍后回来。

sentences.en: We're back with more of the Power Broker Breakdown Breakdown.
sentences.zh: 我们带着《权力掮客拆解之拆解》的更多内容回来了。

sentences.en: So on the last episode, Robert Moses was showing what an amazing visionary he was, but also what a petty tyrant he could be.
sentences.zh: 在上一集中，罗伯特·摩西展示了他是一位多么了不起的远见卓识者，但也展示了他是一个多么琐碎的暴君。

sentences.en: On one hand,
sentences.zh: 一方面，

sentences.en: he was brilliantly taking advantage of these like tax assessments and federal programs and archival research to complete the funding of this massive Westside Manhattan construction project,
sentences.zh: 他巧妙地利用了税收评估、联邦项目和档案研究，完成了曼哈顿西区这个庞大建设项目的所有资金筹措，

sentences.en: which is this amazing chapter and just like how he works down $109 million to something that the city can afford.
sentences.zh: 这是一个精彩的章节，讲述了他如何将1.09亿美元的预算压缩到城市能够负担的程度。

sentences.en: On the other hand, he's destroying neighborhoods, these historic neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，他正在摧毁社区，那些历史悠久的社区。

sentences.en: He's destroying New York's last natural wilderness space without taking anyone else's need into account and harassing the Columbia Yacht Club just because he can,
sentences.zh: 他摧毁了纽约最后一片自然荒野空间，完全不考虑他人的需求，还仅仅因为他能做到，就去骚扰哥伦比亚游艇俱乐部，

sentences.en: because he thought that they were rude to him.
sentences.zh: 因为他觉得他们对他不够礼貌。

sentences.en: It's also becoming clear how much he is using race and class when it comes to his park projects.
sentences.zh: 同样显而易见的是，他在公园项目中是多么严重地利用了种族和阶级问题。

sentences.en: Like he's deliberately underserving New York's poor people and people of color.
sentences.zh: 比如他故意忽视纽约的穷人和有色人种。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, all these bridges and expressways that he's building that are meant to relieve New York's traffic problems are actually seeming to make traffic worse.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他修建的所有这些旨在缓解纽约交通问题的桥梁和高速公路，似乎实际上让交通变得更糟了。

sentences.en: And this is becoming a, this thing that is constant, it's almost a universal truth in when it comes to building bridges and more roads and more lanes, but he cannot see this.
sentences.zh: 这成了一个常态，在修建桥梁、更多道路和更多车道时，这几乎是一个普遍真理，但他却视而不见。

sentences.en: This is his only solution, no matter what the outcome actually proves itself to be.
sentences.zh: 无论最终结果如何，这都是他唯一的解决方案。

sentences.en: And then we've also learned in this just horrible chapter, a good chapter, but a very sad chapter of Robert Moses' relationship with his own family,
sentences.zh: 然后我们还在这一章中了解到，这是一个关于罗伯特·摩西与他自己家庭关系的糟糕章节，虽然写得很好，但非常令人悲伤，

sentences.en: the decades he spent undermining the career and the success of his own brother and his disdain and sort of completely ignoring his sister and just completely undermining the vitality and the life force of Mary,
sentences.zh: 他花费数十年时间破坏自己兄弟的事业和成功，蔑视并完全忽视他的妹妹，还彻底摧毁了玛丽的活力和生命力，

sentences.en: his wife.
sentences.zh: 也就是他的妻子。

sentences.en: So on the last blockbuster episode of the Power Broker Breakdown, we covered Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 在上一期《权力掮客拆解》的重磅节目中，我们讲到了罗伯特·摩西。

sentences.en: He's literally busting blocks.
sentences.zh: 他真的是在“拆毁街区”。

sentences.en: You're not wrong, Robin.
sentences.zh: 你说得没错，罗宾。

sentences.en: He is busting blocks full of people.
sentences.zh: 他确实拆毁了挤满人的街区。

sentences.en: Robert Moses had successfully gained control of every ingress and egress to the island of Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·摩西已经成功控制了曼哈顿岛的所有进出口。

sentences.en: Like if you are in a car and you're trying to get to Manhattan or trying to leave Manhattan and all future river crossings, you have to pay some toll to Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 如果你开车想进入或离开曼哈顿，以及未来所有的河流通道，你都必须向罗伯特·摩西支付过路费。

sentences.en: He controls everything.
sentences.zh: 他控制了一切。

sentences.en: Robert Carra took us through Robert Moses' like turning the public authority into this mutant form that allows him to just have this vast amount of wealth to just keep him going and keep him making new things without having to rely on the fickle public or any politician's approval for anything.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·卡罗带我们了解了罗伯特·摩西如何将公共权力机构变成这种变异形式，使他能够拥有巨额财富，让他能够持续运作并不断创造新事物，而不必依赖反复无常的公众或任何政客的批准。

sentences.en: He controls so much of the money and Moses nearly succeeds in destroying Battery Park in downtown Manhattan with his plans to make it an on-ramp to this enormous bridge to Brooklyn,
sentences.zh: 他控制了太多的资金，摩西差点成功摧毁了曼哈顿市中心的炮台公园，计划将其作为通往布鲁克林巨型大桥的引道，

sentences.en: which the bridge eventually doesn't happen.
sentences.zh: 虽然那座桥最终没建成。

sentences.en: But it takes the power of the president of the United States to stop him from doing this.
sentences.zh: 但需要美国总统出手才能阻止他这样做。

sentences.en: But he takes this years-long revenge, like decade-long revenge of closing New York City's aquarium in place of Fort Clinton.
sentences.zh: 但他进行了长达数年的报复，长达十年的报复，关闭了纽约市的水族馆，取而代之的是克林顿堡。

sentences.en: And then he spends a decade trying to tear down the historic fort.
sentences.zh: 然后他花了十年时间试图拆除这座历史悠久的堡垒。

sentences.en: Again, it just takes the federal government to stop him.
sentences.zh: 同样，只有联邦政府才能阻止他。

sentences.en: And finally, this last little bit of Moses turning into the thing he hates by lending his support to the Tammany candidate, William O'Dwyer.
sentences.zh: 最后，摩西通过支持坦慕尼协会的候选人威廉·奥德怀尔，变成了他所憎恨的那种人。

sentences.en: And in exchange for lending that support, O'Dwyer gives him the post of coordinator of all construction.
sentences.zh: 作为支持的回报，奥德怀尔给了他建设协调员的职位。

sentences.en: He's been the enemy of Tammany for his entire life, and now he's this eager ally.
sentences.zh: 他一生都是坦慕尼协会的敌人，现在却成了热切的盟友。

sentences.en: He lends his name to support and sort of clean up the image of the Tammany candidate.
sentences.zh: 他利用自己的名声来支持并美化坦慕尼候选人的形象。

sentences.en: And we again visit an old, retired, unwell, former politician in the form of Mayor LaGuardia, and he is talking about how much he regrets giving Moses all of this power.
sentences.zh: 我们再次拜访了一位年迈、退休、身体不适的前政客——拉瓜迪亚市长，他谈到了自己是多么后悔给了摩西这么多权力。

sentences.en: What LaGuardia is really nervous about is that now nobody could keep Moses in check.
sentences.zh: 拉瓜迪亚真正担心的是，现在没有人能制约摩西了。

sentences.en: Like he thought he was the last bulwark stopping Moses from running roughshod all over the city of New York.
sentences.zh: 他曾以为自己是阻止摩西在纽约市横行霸道的最后一道防线。

sentences.en: So on the last episode of the 99% Invisible Breakdown of The Power Broker, we covered chapters 33 and 34,
sentences.zh: 在上一集《99%无形：权力掮客拆解》中，我们涵盖了第33章和第34章，

sentences.en: which detailed the ways in which Robert Moses spent the 1940s and 50s becoming the center of political corruption and honest graft in New York City construction world.
sentences.zh: 详细描述了罗伯特·摩西如何在40和50年代成为纽约市建筑界政治腐败和“诚实贪污”的中心。

sentences.en: And his lust for power that has transformed him into this kind of political machine boss that he used to despise when he was a young reformer.
sentences.zh: 他对权力的渴望使他变成了他年轻时作为改革者所鄙视的那种政治机器老板。

sentences.en: And then Caro does this delightful chapter on the three mayors that followed LaGuardia, which did not warrant their own chapters.
sentences.zh: 然后卡罗写了关于拉瓜迪亚之后的三位市长的精彩章节，他们不值得拥有自己的独立章节。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine a version of the book where Mayor Impey gets a full chapter to himself as much as I love that section so much.
sentences.zh: 很难想象这本书里会有市长因佩获得整整一章的篇幅，尽管我非常喜欢那一部分。

sentences.en: So it's just a series of mayors that he dominated during this period of time.
sentences.zh: 所以这只是他在这一时期统治的一系列市长。

sentences.en: So on the last episode of the 99% Invisible Breakdown of The Power Broker, Robert Caro took us on a lavish,
sentences.zh: 在上一集《99%无形：权力掮客拆解》中，罗伯特·卡罗带我们进行了一次奢华的、

sentences.en: luxurious trip to Jones Beach so we could see what it was like to be wined and dined by Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 豪华的琼斯海滩之旅，让我们看看被罗伯特·摩西款待是什么感觉。

sentences.en: And then we watched him ram one mile of expressway through a Bronx neighborhood, needlessly destroying it and bringing misery to the many lives of its occupants in the process.
sentences.zh: 然后我们看着他强行在布朗克斯的一个社区修建了一英里长的高速公路，毫无必要地摧毁了它，并在此过程中给许多居民的生活带来了痛苦。

sentences.en: It was a real rollercoaster of an episode.
sentences.zh: 那真是一集像过山车一样的节目。

sentences.en: It was a real, here's the good news, here's the bad news about Robert and Moses.
sentences.zh: 那真的是一集“关于罗伯特·摩西的好消息和坏消息”。

sentences.en: Truly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And today we'll be covering chapters 39 through 41.
sentences.zh: 今天我们将涵盖第39章到第41章。

sentences.en: That's pages 895 through 983 in my copy of the book.
sentences.zh: 在我这本书里是第895页到第983页。

sentences.en: At this point in the story, Robert Moses is at the height of his power and control, but that doesn't mean it's always going to be that way.
sentences.zh: 在故事的这一点上，罗伯特·摩西正处于权力和控制的巅峰，但这并不意味着它会永远如此。

sentences.en: We're going to be finishing part six, the lust for power and beginning to move into part seven, the loss of power.
sentences.zh: 我们将结束第六部分“对权力的渴望”，并开始进入第七部分“权力的丧失”。

sentences.en: We have arrived.
sentences.zh: 我们到了。

sentences.en: So last time on the 99% Invisible Breakdown of The Power Broker,
sentences.zh: 上次在《99%无形：权力掮客拆解》节目中，

sentences.en: Robert Caro went into incredible detail about how Robert Moses refused to include mass transit as part of his transportation plans.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·卡罗极其详尽地描述了罗伯特·摩西是如何拒绝将公共交通纳入其交通规划的。

sentences.en: And it doomed New York to a future choked with cars and traffic and really explicit detail about how awful different railroads were.
sentences.zh: 这注定了纽约未来将被汽车和交通拥堵所困，书中还详细披露了各种铁路系统是如何糟糕的。

sentences.en: It was very vivid.
sentences.zh: 画面感非常强。

sentences.en: But we also saw how an assortment of activists were starting to recognize the serious issues with how Moses was running his slum clearance programs and the public housing construction projects.
sentences.zh: 但我们也看到，各种活动人士开始意识到摩西在推行贫民窟清理计划和公共住房建设项目时存在严重问题。

sentences.en: So that was a little bit of a glimmer.
sentences.zh: 所以那算是一线曙光。

sentences.en: There were rumors, rumors of rumors.
sentences.zh: 当时有一些传言，关于传言的传言。

sentences.en: So on the last Power Broker Breakdown, we learned that Robert Moses tried to put a parking lot in the tavern in the green, on the tavern in the green, in the tavern on the green.
sentences.zh: 在上一期《权力掮客》深度解析中，我们了解到罗伯特·摩西曾试图在“绿茵酒馆”——也就是那个“绿茵酒馆”——在“绿茵酒馆”里建一个停车场。

sentences.en: I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 我不确定具体怎么说。

sentences.en: One of those.
sentences.zh: 反正就是其中之一。

sentences.en: Choose your own preposition.
sentences.zh: 介词随你选。

sentences.en: And ran against some moms who did not want it there.
sentences.zh: 他因此与一些反对在那儿建停车场的妈妈们发生了冲突。

sentences.en: And it was kind of his first big New York newspaper defeat, which was a big deal, even though the crime itself was probably not as big a deal.
sentences.zh: 那算是他在纽约报界遭遇的第一次重大挫败，这意义重大，尽管那件事本身可能并没有那么严重。

sentences.en: And it sort of tarnished Moses' reputation for infallibility and incorruptibility.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上玷污了摩西那“从不犯错、绝不腐败”的名声。

sentences.en: The New York papers finally got off their duffs and started reporting on corruption in Moses' public housing projects.
sentences.zh: 纽约的报纸终于不再懒散，开始报道摩西公共住房项目中的腐败问题。

sentences.en: One of Moses' aides, the Mustache, tries to pick a fight or does pick a fight with Joe Papp over allowing free Shakespeare in the park.
sentences.zh: 摩西的一名助手，那个“胡子男”，试图或确实与乔·帕普发生了争执，起因是帕普允许在公园里免费表演莎士比亚戏剧。

sentences.en: And this is another one of these just terrible just fumbles that damages Moses' reputation as the champion of the people.
sentences.zh: 这是摩西又一次极其糟糕的失误，损害了他作为“人民捍卫者”的声誉。

sentences.en: And the news media discovers some fairly sort of small ball scandals that are kind of unfair to Moses, as Caro sort of freely admits.
sentences.zh: 新闻媒体发现了一些相对较小的丑闻，正如卡罗坦言的那样，这对摩西来说其实有点不公平。

sentences.en: But they do actually kind of stick to him for the first time.
sentences.zh: 但这些丑闻确实让他第一次陷入了麻烦。

sentences.en: And it encourages him to drop housing as one of the things he covers and resign his city jobs in order to become president of the 1964 World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 这促使他放弃了住房事务，并辞去了市政职务，转而担任1964年世界博览会的主席。

sentences.en: And then after he's lost those city jobs or resigned from those city jobs, the new governor, Nelson Rockefeller, calls Moses' bluff.
sentences.zh: 而在他失去或辞去这些市政职务后，新任州长纳尔逊·洛克菲勒识破了摩西的虚张声势。

sentences.en: They have a little bit of a fight.
sentences.zh: 他们之间发生了一点小冲突。

sentences.en: Moses decides to pull his old trick, threatens to resign from all of his state appointments.
sentences.zh: 摩西决定故技重施，威胁要辞去他所有的州政府职务。

sentences.en: And Rockefeller calls his bluff and he accepts the resignation for his state jobs.
sentences.zh: 但洛克菲勒没有上当，直接接受了他的辞呈。

sentences.en: And this is this is enormous self-own.
sentences.zh: 这简直是搬起石头砸自己的脚。

sentences.en: That would be the true beginning of the end of Moses.
sentences.zh: 那将是摩西时代真正终结的开始。

sentences.en: And in the last section of the power broker breakdown, Governor Nelson Rockefeller's plans to create a new transit authority leaves Robert Moses in the duSt.
sentences.zh: 在《权力掮客》深度解析的最后一部分，纳尔逊·洛克菲勒州长创建新交通管理局的计划，让罗伯特·摩西彻底出局。

sentences.en: And after 44 years, Robert Moses is out of a job.
sentences.zh: 44年后，罗伯特·摩西失业了。

sentences.en: He still dreams of big plans like the Fire Island Highway and new housing projects.
sentences.zh: 他依然梦想着火岛公路和新住房项目等宏大蓝图。

sentences.en: But instead, he finds himself waving his pencil around in front of Robert Caro and giving speeches at various small events.
sentences.zh: 但现实中，他只能在罗伯特·卡罗面前挥舞着铅笔，在各种小型活动上发表演讲。

sentences.en: Always asking, why weren't they grateful?
sentences.zh: 总是问着：为什么他们不懂得感恩？

sentences.zh: 这样你就永远不会忘记自己在2024年读了多少内容。
